definitions: To receive a share of profits, benefits, or advantages from an enterprise or situation.
To participate in something that offers rewards or opportunities.
examples: Everyone wants to get a piece of the pie when a new company goes public.
She felt it was only fair for her to get a piece of the pie after all her hard work.
The smaller businesses are trying to get a piece of the pie in the growing market.
lemma: to get a piece of the pie
synonyms: to get a slice of the cake
to get a share of the spoils
source: to get a piece of the pie
